name: AUI campus buildings, roads, paths and places

metadata.notes: Mapped outlines and pedestrian network may be incomplete. Building heights are unverified visualization estimates. Northern residential building footprints and connecting paths include approximate manual traces from the user-provided satellite image; verify against georeferenced imagery. The north-campus and west-of-8b estimates are georeferenced to the supplied screenshot using existing 8b and campus-pin locations; verify detailed corners and pedestrian links in a surveyed map. A small standard-map ground polygon integrates the west-of-8b residences with the campus land color; it is omitted in satellite mode. New access paths snap to the existing Secondary road and 8b walkway. Current northern, eastern, and west-of-8b additions are traced from the same live satellite camera using map coordinates; building heights remain estimated. Northern, eastern, and west-of-8b building footprints are aligned from roof-color traces on the live campus satellite view; added access roads and footpaths connect into the mapped Main, 39, and Secondary networks. Heights are estimates.
